body:
P1-17 PLAN part 3/3
 T1 raw facts must not depend on the presentation: Android is asked by the state at decision time. T2 Jam out of the core. T3 the player's four reads (canReachServer, networkPresent, internetFound, serverAnswers), two listeners (networkKind, serverReachable) and its own look timers: PR2 only rewires their closures onto the state (the engine's constructor is untouched, so PR2 compiles and its ~60 harness sites stay); PR3 gives the engine ONE read `reachability()` and ONE `recheck()` and ONE listener (away -> not away calls networkChanged), migrates the harness, deletes canReachServerNow; the song-versus-server judging (_judgeFailure, G-1), ReachLook and the retry timers 1,1,2,3 s stay: they DRIVE looks, they define no notion. T4 B-58: D3. T5 teardown: no extra await before the scheduler's in ServerSession.dispose; the new listeners are cancelled before it. T6 B-77: D5. T7 B-78: D6. T8 B-128 collision: awayCauseProvider/AwayCause keep their names, so search_results.dart and genre_screen.dart get no diff in PR2; song_marks.dart gets two lines; the server-kind slice (which rewrites search_results.dart) goes after B-128 has merged.

SLICES (each its own PR, whole app suite green on its own)
 PR1 B-77 + B-78: independent of the state; tests first. AUDIT B-77/B-78 closed.
 PR2 the state and every reach reader: resolver finding, domain type + pure function, providers, strip presenter, readers moved, connectionProblem/serverAway/serverReachable/phoneOnline/phoneHasInternet/connectivity deleted, session listeners on the finding; docs/31 states table; the player's closures rewired only.
 PR3 the player: one read, one recheck(), one listener; docs/33 G-1; AUDIT B-17 reach part closed.
 PR4 server kind: serverKindProvider {detecting, plain, encore} over session.encoreMode + detecting; instantAvailableProvider is NOT a kind (it is the switch plus a service found): derived from the kind and the switch; requestPortalOffered = plain && !instant. `roadmap.py mark P1-17 built` only here. If PR4 does not fit this session, the board note says exactly what remains and the item is not marked.

TESTS THAT MUST BE SEEN FAILING FIRST
 domain truth table; resolver finding transitions (invalidate -> unknown, reportSuccess -> answering after silent); blink filter (blink shows nothing, no network at once, leaving at once, Android asked at decision time); "readers agree" at provider level (strip presenter, awayCauseProvider, the row grey and the player's closure through the real playback_providers wiring, in every state); B-58 with the real session (stays, fails without the listener); B-77 (music server 503 and AuthFailure with the Encore side up: pass completes, an edit from another device appears; probe pulls); B-78 (/info 503, 429, 401-in-error-shape: detecting stays on; 404 and an HTML page: false).
 Golden: screens_golden_test.dart:146 overrides serverReachableProvider with Stream.value(false): I read what that frame shows and make the new override reach the same state at the same pump; no golden is regenerated locally.
